reduction: One hero and ten items out of 57 and 726. Dropped per item: videos, weapon_info, behaviours, dependent_abilities, component_items, update_time. Properties are limited to the keys the tooltip structures reference plus AbilityCooldown, AbilityCastRange and AbilityDuration, without their icon/css/tooltip-layout fields. Description text is verbatim, including inline SVG and unbalanced tags. secondVersion holds two Spirit Lasso property values as served for each client version.

description.desc:
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.

Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
